newsitem.title: USA: NYC sells total of $163 mln in GO bond pre-sale.
newsitem.headline: NYC sells total of $163 mln in GO bond pre-sale.

text.p: New York City sold a total of $163 million so far in its retail order period for a $463 million tax-exempt general obligation bond sale slated for this week.
J.P. Morgan Securities is handling the offering as senior manager and book-runner. The issue is slated for pricing Tuesday.
The city sold $45 million of bonds in retail pre-sale on Monday, the second day of the order period. On Friday, the city sold $118 million.
A city official said the retail order period volume is "about normal for us." --U.S. Municipal Desk, 212-859-1650
